en.title: The Frosted Post Office and the Forgotten God's Prayer
en.premise: Guided by an old, faded photograph left by my late grandfather, I return to the hometown village I had long erased from memory. There I discover the legend of an "Ice Castle" that surfaces only in winter and a deity who sleeps clutching a broken sword to guard the boundary. Undelivered letters lie buried in the snow, and the whispers of the dead begin to reach my ears.

zh.title: 冰霜邮局与被遗忘的神之祈祷
zh.premise: 在已故祖父留下的一张古旧照片的指引下，我踏上了早已从记忆中抹去的故乡小村。那里流传着只在冬季出现的「冰之城」以及为守护界限而抱着断剑沉睡的神的传说。未曾送达的信件埋在雪中，死者的低语开始在我耳边响起。
